features: Dual Cameras for Cinematic Shots - Switch between wide-angle camera for landscapes and med-tele camera for portraits to capture cinematic shots and stunning details in every frame.
Enhanced 1-Inch CMOS & 17-Stop Dynamic Range* - The 1-inch CMOS sensor and 17-stop dynamic range* deliver vivid detail for vlog camera shots in any lighting.
D-Log 2* for Pro-Grade Color - Osmo Pocket 4P’s D-Log 2* color profile preserves highlight and shadow detail, with 10-bit color depth for smooth transitions and flexible grading.
4K/240fps Slow Motion* for Every Highlight - Capture 4K/240fps slow motion* on the wide-angle camera and 4K/200fps* on the med-tele camera for pristine clarity near or far.
4K Live Photo* & Ample Storage - Capture 4K live photos* directly on the device. Store your moments on the 103GB built-in storage, and share them in a flash with 800MB/s* transfer speeds.
3-Axis Stabilization & ActiveTrack* - The 3-axis gimbal lets you capture blur-free footage wherever you go, while ActiveTrack* keeps your subject centered even at 12× zoom*.
Includes Osmo Pocket 4P, Fill Light, DJI Mic Mini 2 Transmitter, Osmo FrameTap, Osmo Mini Tripod, and more. A ready-to-use setup for easy vlogging.
* Battery charger sold separately. It is recommended to purchase the DJI 65W Portable Charger. Please note that DJI Care Refresh must be bound to the product within 30 days of initial activation.
description: Osmo Pocket 4P features a 1-inch wide-angle camera with 17-stop dynamic range* and D-Log 2* for stunning light and shadow, plus a 60mm lens with an f/1.8 aperture for natural portraits. With 3-axis stabilization, ActiveTrack 8.0*, and up to 8× ultra HD slow motion*, cinematic 4K footage* is always within reach.Osmo Pocket 4P comes in 2 purchasing options:- Osmo Pocket 4P Standard Combo is the basic option and includes the gimbal camera, Fill Light, Handle With 1/4′′ Thread, Portable Carrying Pouch, and more. An ideal choice for everyday content creation.- Osmo Pocket 4P Vlog Combo includes the gimbal camera, Fill Light, DJI Mic Mini 2 Transmitter, Osmo FrameTap, Osmo Mini Tripod, and more. A ready-to-use setup for easy vlogging.
